purpose: Teach: 六本木/しみじみ/芸人/クーラー/日焼け/コップ/数える/茶色

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、六本木、絶対、お買い物、絶対、行ってきたわ
lines.en: Sho — Mei-sis went shopping in Roppongi. Really and truly.
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening. Speaking quickly as if bursting with the news. Warm toward the child. Ends with satisfied certainty, like she's just done something good for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、しみじみ、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、優しいって、絶対、思うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really, truly think you're so kind.
lines.style: Soft, genuine delivery. No performance. The slight hesitation of a young child choosing honest words. Voice steady and warm, looking at her directly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、芸人、絶対、いる?本気で
lines.en: Sho — do you have a favorite comedian? I'm curious.
lines.style: Warm, interested lean-in. Genuinely wanting to know what makes him laugh. Light, conversational pace. The tone of someone asking a real question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お家の、本気で、絶対、クーラー、絶対、効いてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — the AC at home is working really well right now.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Small child noticing something practical. Voice is steady, unselfconscious. Brief, like he's just making conversation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、海で、絶対、日焼け、絶対、しちゃってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad got really sunburned at the beach.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly sympathetic tone. Not worried, just noticing something he saw happen. Quiet delivery, like he's remembering the image. Gentle concern underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、コップ、絶対、新しいの、絶対、ママに、絶対、買ってもらった
lines.en: Mei-sis — Mom bought me a new cup. I'm really happy about it.
lines.style: Eager, bright delivery. The small pride of a six-year-old with something new. Quick cadence on the good news. Voice lifts slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お友達、絶対、数える、絶対、と、絶対、何人?本気で
lines.en: Sho — how many friends do you have when you count them all? I wonder.
lines.style: Curious, thoughtful question. Child pace — a beat between the clauses like he's actually thinking. Genuine wonder, not testing. Reaches toward her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、茶色、絶対、のクマ、絶対、大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really love brown bears. They're my favorite.
lines.style: Warm, unselfconscious affection. Simple declaration of something he adores. Close to her voice, comfortable. Slight emphasis on the word brown, like it matters to him.
